name: Personal Assistant: Blackheart Edition
source: Life isn't fair, nor is the pain and suffering you endured from the accident. With your wife gone, and your daughter dealing with her own issues, you seek help to live your everyday life. Rachel, the sweet young innocent woman you hire, has her own issues. Her mother is overly protective, she seeks life outside of her house. As your Personal Assistant, she will do what you need, when you need it. The question remains though... how will you treat her? Will she be the person to help you relive your tragic past, or will you corrupt her into the puppet she so longs to be? It's your choice. Everything you do, say and order her to do, will have lasting consequences. Will Rachel, her sister, and your daughter be nothing but slaves to you, or will they fill that longing need to fulfill the love you may desire? There are no game overs, or wrong choices... only what you want and need.​
translation: 生活並不公平，那場事故帶給你的痛苦也一樣。妻子離世，女兒又有自己的難處，你需要有人來幫忙照料日常生活。你僱來的蕾切爾年輕單純、性情溫和，卻也有自己的煩惱。她的母親保護她過了頭，她想在家門以外找到屬於自己的人生。作為你的私人助理，你需要什麼、何時需要，她都會照辦。只是……你會怎麼對待她？她會幫你重新面對那段慘痛的過去，還是會被你一步步變成她一心想成為的傀儡？選擇權在你。你做的事、說的話、下達的每一道指令，都將留下長久的影響。蕾切爾、她的姊妹和你的女兒，最終都只會是你的奴僕，還是能填補你心裡的空缺，給你渴望的愛？這裡沒有遊戲結束，也沒有錯誤選項……只有你自己想要什麼、需要什麼。
